title: You are the mob
description: You Are The Mob turns you into the world’s enemy — villagers run from you, iron golems hunt you, and no one welcomes you anymore… But you’re not alone, monsters are on your side now.
body:
You used to be the hero…
Now you’re the problem.

Villagers see you = instant panic
Iron Golems see you = hands rated E for Everyone
That village you protected? Yeah… they want you gone.

But hey—
you’re not alone anymore.

Zombies don’t attack you
Creepers are your coworkers
Skeletons got your back

![You are the mob](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb584a4ebbb5303bd34c13798660da873800669a.png)

The world doesn’t hate you…
it fears you.
